description: Experimental ABI revision zero. No stability promise exists yet. See api/README.md for ownership rules and lifetimes.

threads.name: any
threads.description: Any thread may call the function.

threads.name: becomes_owner
threads.description: The calling thread becomes the owner of the engine that the call creates. The host must destroy the engine before that thread exits.

threads.name: owner
threads.description: Only the thread that created the engine may call the function. The engine checks the calling thread before any other argument, and a call from another thread returns {status:wrong_thread}.

lifetimes.name: call
lifetimes.description: Ends when the call returns. The engine keeps no reference to the storage afterward.

lifetimes.name: request_end
lifetimes.description: Ends when the request ends. A step ends a request when it applies the request's response, rejection, or cancellation. The engine ends a request when a new load, a document destruction, or an engine destruction cancels it.

lifetimes.name: next_load_or_destroy
lifetimes.description: Ends when {function:document_load} loads the document again, when {function:document_destroy} destroys the document, or when {function:engine_destroy} destroys its engine.

lifetimes.name: document_destroy
lifetimes.description: Ends when {function:document_destroy} destroys the document or {function:engine_destroy} destroys its engine.

statuses.description: Status codes. Every function except {function:abi_revision} returns one.

members.name: invalid_argument
members.description: A null required pointer, a short structure or output size, or an unknown enumeration value.

members.name: unknown_id
members.description: The identifier is not live in this engine.

members.name: invalid_state
members.description: The request already has a queued answer.

members.name: unsupported_version
members.description: The response version differs from the request version.

members.name: limit_exceeded
members.description: A request bound, a body bound, or an identifier space was exhausted.

members.name: wrong_thread
members.description: The caller is not the thread that created the engine.

members.name: loading
members.description: A request for the document's resource is outstanding.

members.name: loaded
members.description: A step applied a response, and the document holds its body.

members.name: failed
members.description: A step applied a rejection or a host cancellation.

members.name: resource
members.description: A request for the bytes of a document's resource.

members.name: unsupported_version
members.description: The host does not implement the request's version.

members.name: document_state_changed
members.description: A document moved to a new state.

constants.name: resource_request_version
constants.description: The only version of the resource request kind.

constants.name: deadline_none
constants.description: The next deadline when no deadline exists. No timer exists yet, so every step reports it.

handles.name: engine
handles.description: An engine. It belongs to the thread that created it. The host must destroy it before that thread exits, because the system can reuse the identifier of an exited thread.

identifiers.name: document
identifiers.description: A document identifier. It is nonzero, unique within the process, and never reused. A call that fails after it takes an identifier skips that identifier.

identifiers.name: request
identifiers.description: A request identifier. It is nonzero, unique within the process, and never reused. Document and request identifiers come from one sequence, so they never coincide. A call that fails after it takes an identifier skips that identifier.

fields.name: feature_bits
fields.description: The implemented browser capabilities. The mask is zero in the bootstrap.

structures.name: engine_options
structures.description: Input. struct_size must be at least {size:engine_options}.

fields.name: max_outstanding_requests
fields.description: The maximum number of requests that are outstanding at once.

fields.name: max_response_body_bytes
fields.description: The maximum size of one response body in bytes.

fields.name: max_allocated_bytes
fields.description: The most bytes that the engine's allocations may hold at once. 18446744073709551615 permits every allocation that the process allocator grants.

fields.name: allocated_bytes
fields.description: The bytes that the engine's live allocations hold.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The loaded body, or null when body_len is zero.

structures.name: response
structures.description: Input. struct_size must be at least {size:response}.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The response body. It may be null when body_len is zero, and the engine copies it during the call.

fields.name: work_remaining
fields.description: One when queued input remains, otherwise zero.

fields.name: applied
fields.description: The number of queued inputs that the step applied.

fields.name: events_ready
fields.description: The number of events that are ready to drain.

structures.name: event
structures.description: Output of {function:engine_next_event}. Fields that do not apply to the kind are zero or null.

fields.name: document_state
fields.description: The new state for a {event:document_state_changed} event.

fields.name: reject_reason
fields.description: The rejection reason when an applied rejection failed the document.

fields.name: url
fields.description: For a {event:request_issued} event, the request URL while the request is live. It is null when the URL is empty, when the request has ended, and for every other kind.

functions.name: query_capabilities
functions.description: On success, this function initializes the declared capability structure. The feature mask is zero in the bootstrap. On an invalid size or a null output, no output bytes change.

functions.name: engine_create
functions.description: Creates an engine on the calling thread and stores it in the output. Every allocation of the engine, including the engine itself, counts against the allocation limit of the options.

functions.name: engine_destroy
functions.description: Releases the engine and everything it owns, including outstanding requests, queued answers, undrained events, and every borrowed URL and body.

functions.name: engine_get_memory
functions.description: Initializes the declared engine memory structure with the bytes that the engine's live allocations hold and the current limit. The call allocates nothing.

functions.name: engine_set_memory_limit
functions.description: Replaces the most bytes that the engine's allocations may hold at once. A limit below the bytes that the live allocations hold is accepted. An allocation that the limit refuses fails like any other allocation, so its call returns {status:out_of_memory} and changes nothing. The call allocates nothing.

parameters.name: max_allocated_bytes
parameters.description: The new limit. 18446744073709551615 permits every allocation that the process allocator grants.

functions.name: document_create
functions.description: Creates an empty document and stores its identifier in the output.

functions.name: document_destroy
functions.description: Releases the document. An outstanding request is cancelled and announced, and its queued answer is discarded. The call never allocates, because the load that issued the request reserved its cancellation event.

functions.name: document_get
functions.description: Initializes the declared document information structure with the document state and body.

functions.name: document_load
functions.description: Issues a {enumeration:request_kind.resource} request with version {constant:resource_request_version} for a copy of url and stores its identifier in the output. The url may be null when url_len is zero, and the engine copies it during the call. A load while the document is loading cancels the earlier request. The load reserves the storage of the request's cancellation event, so {function:document_destroy} never allocates.

functions.name: request_respond
functions.description: Queues a response. The engine copies the body during the call.

functions.name: request_reject
functions.description: Queues a rejection with a {enumeration:reject_reason} value.

functions.name: request_cancel
functions.description: Queues the host's withdrawal of a request.

functions.name: engine_step
functions.description: Applies up to budget queued answers in arrival order. The budget is an engine scheduling boundary only. It creates no JavaScript task boundary.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: The maximum number of queued inputs to apply.

functions.name: engine_next_event
functions.description: Removes the oldest event and initializes the declared event structure with it. When no event is ready, the kind is {enumeration:event_kind.none}.

events.description: A load issued a request. The URL is present while the request is live and the URL is not empty, and null otherwise.
A request ended by cancellation, either the host's or the engine's.
A document moved to a new state. The event names the request whose issuance or ending caused the change. A change caused by an applied rejection names the reason.
